column_description: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, uniquely identifying each light/radiation reading.
BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing EnvironmentalReadingsCore(EnvReadRegistry). Associates light data with an existing environment reading.
INT measuring visible light intensity in lux.

NUMERIC(6,2) measuring infrared radiation in W/m².
INT indicating total visible light exposure over time in lux-hours (Lx·h).
